2. Equipment Manager - To be responsible for care, storage, issuing and inventorying all athletic equipment in the senior high school buildings.

3. Intramurals--Each supervisor will be paid on the basis of each session. The number of supervisors to be determined by the athletic director and principal. $2,000 budgeted per year.
